event_state.state_basis: all chronological F05 signals, including blocked probe signals
event_state.active_event: one F05 event with direction, anchor signal UTC, anchor signal close and accepted-trade count
event_state.new_event: when no event exists, the event expired, or an opposite-direction F05 signal occurs
event_state.new_event_action: record the current F05 signal as the probe anchor and block that F05 trade
event_state.same_direction_signal_action: evaluate confirmation and event trade budget
event_state.opposite_signal_action: terminate the old event, create a new opposite-direction probe and block the current F05 trade
event_state.event_memory_dependency: does not require an accepted/open position and survives blocking of the probe trade
processing_order_same_timestamp: process and always accept B02 using unchanged baseline logic
apply optional same-time B02 confirmation override
record accepted or blocked F05 signal in audit

candidate_rule.default: the first F05 signal of each event is a non-trading probe
candidate_rule.confirmation: a later same-direction F05 signal is eligible when side * (current_signal_close - anchor_signal_close) in pips is at least C and event age is at most A
candidate_rule.trade_budget: accepted F05 count within the event must be below N
candidate_rule.same_time_B02_override: when enabled, a same-time same-direction B02 signal may confirm the current F05 without a prior F05 probe; the F05 is accepted and initializes the event anchor at its signal close
candidate_rule.accepted_trade_exit: unchanged accepted baseline F05 fixed time-cap exit
candidate_rule.blocked_trade_effect: the baseline F05 trade and its P/L are removed; no later event state is removed because all F05 signals remain observational events

post_H2_action.H2_fail: close Family F and do not access 2025; activate the 2023 low-download M1-bar fallback plan
post_H2_action.H2_pass: freeze one exact specification for Core implementation and exact 2024 MT4 parity before any new 2025 H1 execution authorization

2023_fallback.trigger: no Family F specification passes 2024 H1 and H2
2023_fallback.preferred_data: compressed 2023 M1 OHLC bars with deterministic M15 derivation
2023_fallback.tick_data_deferred_until: a later candidate requires intrabar ordering, variable spread, stop/target/trailing execution, or tick-equity validation
